title: Prime factors of fusion-category dimensions: weak group-theoreticity, rank and decomposition
authors: Sebastian Burciu, Jingcheng Dong and Sébastien Palcoux
summary: Develops prime-factor criteria for weak group-theoreticity and decomposition of fusion categories. A non-pointed simple integral modular fusion category must have rank at least 32; the bounds are 33 in nonsquare dimension, 57 in odd dimension, and 75 in odd nonsquare dimension.
verification: Code, input data, calculation manifests, and explicit certificates are published in the verification repository.

title: Low-rank Grothendieck rings: an AI-assisted classification project, constructions, and open problems
summary: Explores which low-rank fusion rings admit fusion categories over the complex numbers, with constructions, exclusion arguments, open cases, and computational data.
verification: AI-generated research · independent verification pending. Results and computations remain provisional.
